grain_rationale: row_count is 13014 and duplicate_row_rate is 0.0, with airport_code distinct_count of 3 and observed_hour_utc distinct_count of 4341, roughly 3 airports times ~4341 hourly timestamps matching the total row count, so each row is one hourly observation at one airport; the derived identity over (airport_code, observed_hour_utc) uniquely identifies each row and there are no exact duplicate rows for it to absorb.

fields.name: airport_code
fields.description: The three-letter station code (EWR, JFK, LGA per distinct_values) identifying which NYC-area airport the observation belongs to, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_utc
fields.description: The UTC timestamp of the hourly observation, sampled with minute components all at :00:00 (e.g. 2013-01-01T06:00:00), spanning 2013-01-01 to 2013-07-01 with null_rate 0.0, so this is the event time column at hour grain.

fields.name: observed_date_local
fields.description: The local calendar date of the observation (e.g. 2013-01-01 through 2013-06-30 per min/max), a labeling attribute with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: observed_hour_local
fields.description: The local hour of day of the observation, ranging 0 to 23 per the 24 distinct values, a labeling attribute rather than a summed quantity, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: temp_f
fields.description: Air temperature in degrees Fahrenheit per operator context, ranging 10.94 to 93.92 across 130 distinct values, a measured quantity compared across rows, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: dewpoint_f
fields.description: Dewpoint temperature in degrees Fahrenheit per operator context, ranging -9.94 to 73.94 across 119 distinct values, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: humidity_pct
fields.description: Relative humidity percentage, ranging 12.74 to 100.0 across 2178 distinct values, a continuously measured quantity, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: wind_dir_degrees
fields.description: Wind direction in compass degrees (0-360, 37 distinct values) per operator context; treated as a categorical label since direction is circular and not meaningfully summed, nullable with null_rate 0.016828.

fields.name: wind_speed_mph
fields.description: Wind speed in miles per hour per operator context, ranging 0.0 to 1048.36058 across 36 distinct values, nullable with null_rate 0.000154.

fields.name: wind_gust_mph
fields.description: Wind gust speed in miles per hour per operator context, ranging 16.11092 to 62.14212 across 35 distinct values, nullable with a high null_rate of 0.745505 likely because gusts are only recorded when they exceed a threshold.

fields.name: precip_inches
fields.description: Precipitation in inches per operator context, ranging 0.0 to 1.06 across 50 distinct values, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: pressure_mb
fields.description: Atmospheric pressure in millibars per operator context, ranging 983.8 to 1038.4 across 430 distinct values, nullable with null_rate 0.114953.

fields.name: visibility_miles
fields.description: Visibility in miles per operator context, with 20 distinct values ranging 0.0 to 10.0, a measured quantity with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_name
fields.description: The full airport name joined from OurAirports (e.g. John F. Kennedy International Airport per distinct_values), with null_rate 0.0 reflecting the complete airport join declared in the source contract.

fields.name: airport_municipality
fields.description: The municipality of the airport (New York or Newark per distinct_values), with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_elevation_ft
fields.description: The airport's elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21 per distinct_values), a static labeling attribute of the airport rather than a measured event quantity, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: airport_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: The airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511 per distinct_values), a static airport attribute, with null_rate 0.0.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: The ingestion capture timestamp of the record (distinct_values clustered around 2026-09-02T23:26:11-13), not the business event time, carried as a dimension with null_rate 0.0.

category_description: One row represents a single hourly weather observation recorded at one of the three NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA per airport_code distinct_values), joined to static airport attributes such as elevation and longest runway.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_airport_weather table's hourly airport observations enter the gold unified event star as the airport_weather_observations fact category, for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models to consume.
usage: The deterministic modeling engine renders this proposal into the ODCS gold mapping contract, which the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint validate before a human reviewer approves or edits the draft; nothing in this proposal executes on its own.
limitations: This mapping does not aggregate or impute the nullable wind_gust_mph (null_rate 0.745505), pressure_mb (null_rate 0.114953), wind_dir_degrees (null_rate 0.016828), or wind_speed_mph (null_rate 0.000154) readings, leaving null handling to downstream consumers; it also does not re-verify the airport join completeness beyond citing the operator-declared contract guarantee, and it introduces no filters or transformations beyond the stated row identity.
